commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Samuel Barrott's book.
90+8' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) was probably a bit loose with his words to Samuel Barrott, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+5' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.

90+3' 4 - 3 Lucas Digne sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 4:3.

90+3' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Emiliano Martinez anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

87' 3 - 3 Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
86' 3 - 2 That was a nice piece of skill by Trai Hume (Sunderland)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 3:2.
